sourceSpecificity.selection: Every one of the 40 prelocked moves appears exactly once in the required publication order, including the five preauthorized asymmetric fourth rows; no scored move was merged, reassigned or omitted.
sourceSpecificity.prose: Descriptions state the particular claim and its warrant or consequence; the 20-word Earth card identifies both the multiple habitability conditions and the design inference. Critiques retain the actual strongest feature, limitation, remaining burden and frozen score in four complete sentences, with no shared six-word critique boilerplate.
sourceSpecificity.scopeReview: The direct review compared suspected source and burden defects with the source spans, audio qualifications and accepted assessment rationales. Seven accepted copyedits remove transcription uncertainty as criticism, preserve Boteach’s guided-development position, avoid imposing a complete moral theory on Hitchens’s bounded rebuttals, and improve two AI openings. All other previously reviewed prose remains unchanged.
sourceSpecificity.historicalClaims: The source note and historical critiques distinguish an asserted citation from verified historical fact. The court discussion preserves the distinction between a secondary book, a secular court and a rabbinical tribunal without blaming uncertainty in overlapping speech on either participant.
sourceSpecificity.quotationReview: Both short quotations are exact eligible locked strings with the correct speaker and source passage. Neither enters an audio-quarantined interval or uses malformed wording. Canonical final-ledger citations replace filtered-view citations only in metadata.

aiContributionReview.openings: Read the opening words and sentence structures of both theses, both conclusions, all ten premises and all six reinforcing arguments together. The reinforcing items now start with normative reasons, mathematical intelligibility, moral protest, the interaction of divine attributes, explanatory cost, and moral interpretation respectively; they do not share interchangeable launchers.
aiContributionReview.distinctInferentialWork: The pro additions compare normative realism, joint world/mind intelligibility and relational protest; the con additions test joint attributes, predictive flexibility and the priority of moral judgment over scripture. Their objections and qualifications are specific to those inferences, not mirrored frames.
aiContributionReview.substanceAndDisclosure: The two natural-language repairs preserve their original substantive arguments. The separate user-authorized disclosure correction changes only were generated by AI to are AI-generated. The AI section remains clearly separate from participant claims and has no score effect.
aiContributionReview.punctuation: Lists, restrictive clauses, introductory phrases, semicolons and conditional conclusions retain normal punctuation. Simple one-sentence premises without commas were directly inspected and do not exhibit punctuation loss. The private production validator’s corpus-wide punctuation check passed.
aiContributionReview.referenceOverlap: No normalized six-word sequence in the full AI Contribution matched the independent 25-debate reference window; this was treated as supporting evidence, not a substitute for reading the prose.
aiContributionReview.novelty: All eight required novelty entries retain their source-move references and hypothetical status; no extension item is scored as participant performance.

outlierReasons.motionWords: Does God exist? is the exact three-word authorized motion. Expanding it to resemble longer reference questions would alter the frozen burden.
outlierReasons.sections: Seven semantic sections preserve distinct existence, design, evolutionary, moral, scriptural, historical and covenant exchanges across the full substantive recording; the count is inside the hard 4–7 contract.
outlierReasons.rows: Twenty-five rows are required by the prelocked 40 moves, including unpaired replies and five evidence-led asymmetric fourth rows. Filling, deleting or merging cards to imitate the shorter reference debates would distort the inventory.
outlierReasons.moves: Forty distinct load-bearing moves were frozen before assessment, twenty per side. The source contains sustained rebuttals and later historical/covenantal exchanges, unlike a highlights-only record; coverage rather than a quota determines count.
outlierReasons.critiqueWordsMean: The four-sentence critiques cover the specific inference, support, strongest feature and remaining burden within the unchanged 105–130-word and minimum-character gates. The modest mean excess over the reference maximum is not boilerplate: common six-word coverage is zero.
outlierReasons.quoteContextWordsMean: The 24- and 22-word contexts explain the limited role of local-order testimony and the concession of first-cause possibility. These distinctions prevent exaggeration, while both contexts remain inside the hard range.
outlierReasons.strengthWordsMean: Each strength names concrete argumentative conduct and why it matters, within the 18–30-word packet range. The modestly longer mean avoids empty praise.
outlierReasons.extensionPremiseWordsMean: The 18–23-word premises state complete source-linked inferential steps, including their relevant contrast or qualification. The mean is only slightly below the independent minimum, exceeds every hard minimum, and contains no shorthand placeholders.
